title: Dependable event coordination
summary: Event invitations, pairing rules, gift-exchange actions, and deletion now remain clear and recoverable when requests fail.
highlights: Event deletion failures remain visible in the confirmation dialog with a clear retry.
Pairing-rule loading failures are distinct from an empty rule list and provide a retry action.
Pairing-rule changes prevent duplicate requests and announce success or actionable failure.
Drawing names and resetting a gift exchange show safe guidance without exposing internal errors.
Invitation loading, friend selection, and invitation actions expose progress, recovery, and completion.

title: Truthful loading and friend actions
summary: Wishlist, friend, and dashboard workflows now communicate loading and failures more clearly while protecting repeated actions.
highlights: Personal wishlist failures appear as actionable errors instead of empty results.
Friends' wishlist failures remain distinct from a genuinely empty shared list.
Friend invitations expose progress, prevent duplicate sends, and explain authentication or delivery failures.
Friend loading and removal provide retryable errors, named controls, accurate sharing consequences, duplicate-action protection, and completion feedback.
The personalized dashboard exposes its loading state to assistive technology.

title: Comfortable mobile controls
summary: Wishlist and Secret Santa actions are easier to reach on phones without obscuring nearby content.
highlights: The mobile add-item action stays in the wishlist flow with a visible label instead of floating over content.
Wishlist item edit and delete actions have explicit names and comfortable mobile touch targets.
Wishlist filter, sort, and view controls provide consistent 44-pixel mobile touch targets.
Secret Santa setup actions expand safely on small screens and meet the mobile touch-target guideline.
Comment deletion and reservation release confirmations provide larger mobile actions.

title: Dependable creation and dialogs
summary: Wishlist creation and confirmation workflows now provide safer keyboard behavior and truthful progress and failure states.
highlights: Confirmation dialogs contain keyboard focus, close with Escape, and return focus to their opener.
Wishlist visibility uses native, mutually exclusive radio choices with dependable keyboard focus.
Wishlist creation prevents duplicate submissions and keeps actionable failures on the form.
Standalone item creation prevents duplicate submissions and keeps actionable failures on the form.
Secret Santa assignment failures provide a clear retry action instead of appearing as no assignment.

title: Safer coordination actions
summary: Event navigation, reservations, comments, and friend requests now provide clearer keyboard behavior and dependable feedback.
highlights: Event cards provide an explicit, named navigation link for keyboard and screen-reader users.
Reserved-item refreshes announce progress and results, and identify links that open a new tab.
Friend-request actions name the person involved, prevent duplicate updates, and announce outcomes.
Comment deletion requires a focused confirmation and explains that removal is permanent.
Reservation cancellation requires a focused confirmation and explains when the item becomes available again.

title: Clearer discovery and notifications
summary: Wishlist discovery, friend invitations, and notification actions now provide faster and more dependable feedback.
highlights: Wishlist discovery filters immediately, includes a clear action, and announces empty results.
Friend invitations connect guidance and feedback while preventing empty submission.
The notification panel communicates its open state, keeps background controls unavailable, and manages keyboard focus.
Notification deletion clearly names the item, explains permanence, and begins on the safe action.
Notification updates expose busy, success, and failure states.

title: Accessible wishlist browsing
summary: Wishlist discovery and item capture now communicate their controls and current state more clearly.
highlights: Item search announces matching ideas and provides a clearly named reset action.
Filters and sorting communicate which options are active.
Grid and list controls identify the current view.
Product URL import fields include connected guidance and prevent empty imports.
The add-item dialog starts at the product URL, contains keyboard focus, and returns it to the opener when closed.

title: Accessible event coordination
summary: Event coordination controls now give keyboard and screen-reader users clearer state and context.
highlights: Invitation filters announce their selected status and matching invitations.
Invitation and removal dialogs identify their purpose, choices, and consequences.
Wishlist attachment and pairing-rule controls keep their visible labels connected.

title: Clearer gift coordination controls
summary: Wishlist and event controls now provide clearer context when using a keyboard or screen reader.
highlights: Wishlist tabs, search controls, and results communicate their current content and state.
Gift reservation and comment controls identify when their details are open.
Event deletion confirmation clearly describes its permanent consequence.

title: Reliable release versioning
summary: OpenWish builds now report the same version as the current release.
highlights: Compiled assembly metadata, release information, and the What's new page stay synchronized.

title: Google sign-in handoff
summary: Google sign-in can now navigate to Google's authorization page.
highlights: The browser form destination policy permits Google's authorization origin only when Google sign-in is configured.

title: Google sign-in route
summary: Google sign-in submits to the correct account endpoint.
highlights: The login form uses the root-relative external authentication route.

title: Clearer loading updates
summary: Loading updates now say what OpenWish is working on.
highlights: Screen readers receive contextual loading updates without duplicate announcements from decorative button spinners.

title: Clearer product links
summary: Product links now make it clearer where they lead.
highlights: Wishlist product links identify the item they open for screen-reader users and safely open in a new tab.

title: Sustainable improvements
summary: A stronger foundation for consistent product updates and verified releases.
highlights: Release highlights are now available directly in OpenWish.
Wishlist, event, and friend pages share a clearer visual hierarchy.
Browser verification covers owner, guest, and friend journeys across desktop and mobile layouts.
A verified walkthrough demonstrates wishlists, events, gift exchange, friends, notifications, and responsive use.
An isolated agent-managed environment can be promoted without changing the developer's Aspire data or ports.
Private social, event, notification, activity, and reservation data is now protected by stricter authorization and privacy controls.
Self-hosted deployments now include safer login, proxy, browser, email, and product-link defaults.
Google sign-in now recovers unconfirmed linked accounts through email confirmation instead of asking users to link again.
Notification deletion now updates immediately and reports failures instead of closing without feedback.
Creation forms now focus their first useful field, and wishlists include a compact icon picker.
Invitation registration now clearly keeps the email address that received the invitation.
Wishlist collaboration actions now consistently use the signed-in user's identity.
Local time formatting is safer and accurate across partial-hour time zones.
